newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF asks panels to discuss 'Big Bang' reform.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF asks panels to discuss 'Big Bang' reform.

text.p: Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka has asked the chairmen of various government panels to come up with plans quickly in order to to complete financial market reforms by the year 2001, a MOF official said on Friday.

Mitsuzuka met separately with the heads of five government panels in the afternoon to discuss reforms of the financial system, foreign exchange, securities, insurance and corporate accounting. He explained Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's "Big Bang" plan to liberalise Japan's financial markets over the next five years.

The Finance Minister asked the chairmen to hold active and serious discussions on the prime minister's financial liberalisation plans, the official said. He added that Mitsuzuka would attend panel discussions as needed.
